title: Gamification of mathematics off the charts
author: Michael Harris

metaphors.title: Gift economy and the great heist
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematics as a gift economy, not a branch of the market, against which AI's use of the literature is the greatest math heist in history, a Grand Theft of the commons.
metaphors.style_hint: A wrapped gift beside a vault being emptied.

metaphors.title: A downpour of fertilizer
metaphors.paraphrase: The deluge of AI-generated texts as fertilizer: nutrients eventually to be absorbed into human papers.

metaphors.title: Theorems named like lunar craters
metaphors.paraphrase: Naming rights over AI-produced results are prestige like craters on the moon or galaxies at the edge of the visible universe.
metaphors.style_hint: A telescope pointed at a cratered moon.

metaphors.title: Champion gamers prompting
metaphors.paraphrase: Chasing breakthroughs with bespoke prompts is a competitive game, gamified mathematics as the killer app AI firms need to stay afloat.
metaphors.style_hint: An arcade cabinet with a leaderboard.
